record.context_brief: Finiteness of equilibria for positive charges
record.original_question: Does every configuration of N positive electric charges in R^d have only finitely many equilibrium points?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3. Any configuration of N positive electric charges in R^d has only finitely many points of equilibrium.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $N \geq 2$ and $d \geq 2$ be integers, and let $x_1, \dots, x_N$ be distinct points in $\mathbb{R}^d$ with associated positive real numbers (charges) $q_1, \dots, q_N > 0$. Define the electrostatic potential generated by these point charges by
$$U(x) = \sum_{i=1}^{N} \frac{q_i}{\|x - x_i\|^{d-2}} \quad (d \neq 2), \qquad U(x) = -\sum_{i=1}^{N} q_i \log\|x - x_i\| \quad (d = 2),$$
defined on $\mathbb{R}^d \setminus \{x_1, \dots, x_N\}$. An equilibrium point is a point $x \in \mathbb{R}^d \setminus \{x_1, \dots, x_N\}$ at which $\nabla U(x) = 0$.

Prove or disprove: for every $N$, every $d$, every choice of distinct positions $x_1, \dots, x_N$, and every choice of positive charges $q_1, \dots, q_N$, the set of equilibrium points of $U$ is finite.
artifact.status_search_result: This is a form of Maxwell's conjecture on point charges. Finiteness (and the sharper bound $(N-1)^2$) is generally believed but not established in full generality. Gabrielov, Novikov and Shapiro (2007) proved a finite upper bound for non-degenerate configurations in $\mathbb{R}^3$, and finiteness has been established in special low-$N$ cases (e.g., $N=3$). The general finiteness question (without non-degeneracy assumptions) remains open as of recent work in 2025.

status_evidence.title: Mystery of Point Charges
status_evidence.snippet: Gabrielov, Novikov, Shapiro establish a finite upper bound on equilibria for non-degenerate configurations of positive charges in R^3.
status_evidence.claim: Finite upper bound known only for non-degenerate configurations; general case open.

status_evidence.title: Counting Equilibria of the Electrostatic Potential
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work continues to study upper bounds on the number of equilibria of electrostatic potentials of positive point charges, indicating the conjecture remains active.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture remains open with ongoing research on bounds.

status_evidence.title: Maxwell's conjecture on three point charges with equal magnitudes
status_evidence.snippet: Proof of Maxwell's conjecture in the special case of three equal positive charges.
status_evidence.claim: Only special low-N cases have been fully resolved.
